implementation_notes: Canonical implementation surfaces: skeleton/eval, skeleton/runtime.

implementation_notes: Primary contracts: EvaluationFarmJob, EvalWorker, EvaluationFarmResult.
Security-sensitive serialization uses stable identity/versioning, canonical parsing, explicit absent/null behavior and migration semantics.
acceptance: Round-trip plus malformed/duplicate/unknown-value tests exist.
Compatibility policy fails closed on unsafe ambiguity.

implementation_levels.name: Admission & authority
implementation_notes: Distribute evaluation jobs from immutable eval/model/dataset specs.
Attach principal/tenant, policy version, capability, budget, deadline and idempotency identity before protected work.
acceptance: Unauthorized/over-budget work causes no privileged side effect.
Fallback never weakens privacy, residency, authority or tenant isolation.

implementation_levels.name: Runtime control flow
implementation_notes: Results bind to worker/environment/scorer identity and aggregate deterministically.
normalize -> authorize -> reserve -> execute bounded capability -> persist/emit -> verify -> finalize receipt.
acceptance: Cancellation/deadline reaches every child operation.
No retry/recursion/delegation/search/background loop is unbounded.

implementation_levels.name: State & data semantics
implementation_notes: State authority must distinguish durable truth from projection/cache/ephemeral data; projection loss must be recoverable from authority.
Durable changes use transaction/outbox or explicit idempotency/compensation; declared derived state is rebuildable.
acceptance: Acknowledged authoritative writes are not silently lost.
Retention/deletion/migration/rebuild semantics are executable.

implementation_levels.name: Security, privacy & tenancy
implementation_notes: Zero-trust checks occur at the last responsible moment; identity, purpose, classification, residency and revocation follow protected work.
Threat/failure focus: worker scorer drift | duplicate evaluation.
acceptance: Critical authz/tenant/secret/injection failures are non-compensable.
No undeclared protected material enters logs/prompts/artifacts/telemetry.

implementation_levels.name: Failure, resilience & recovery
implementation_notes: Open obligations: bind Evaluation SDK | reuse worker attestation.
Define timeout outcome, retry budget, circuit/bulkhead/backpressure, crash boundary, replay behavior and recovery checkpoint for Evaluation Farm.
acceptance: Fault injection covers dependency, crash, replay, saturation, cancellation, stale identity and rollback.
Recovery creates no duplicate privileged effect or authority violation.

implementation_levels.name: Observability & operability
implementation_notes: Trace Evaluation Farm through decisions, dependencies, state, evidence and terminal result.
Emit structured success/failure, p50/p95/p99 where applicable, queue/resource pressure, retries, cost and recovery telemetry with redaction.
acceptance: Failed operations are reconstructable without process-local memory.

implementation_levels.name: Performance, capacity & economics
implementation_notes: Comparator: generic remote job queue without workload attestation or immutable specs
Reserve scarce resource/cost before expensive work; saturation uses bounded queueing/routing/shedding/rejection.
acceptance: Qualification includes tail and saturation behavior.
Optimization dequalifies when source/policy/profile identity is stale.

implementation_levels.name: Verification & adversarial evaluation
implementation_notes: Focused tests: planned:skeleton/testing/test_evaluation_farm.py.

Verification must map each masterplan requirement, declared risk, trust boundary, concurrency invariant, and recovery obligation to deterministic tests or immutable evaluation evidence; every discovered failure becomes a versioned regression before promotion.
acceptance: Happy, negative, adversarial, concurrency and recovery behavior are exercised.
High-impact verification is independent or deterministically separated.

implementation_levels.name: Deployment, migration & rollback
implementation_notes: Deployment binds exact source/config/contracts/data migration/dependencies/artifact provenance.
Canary/readiness observes correctness, SLO, safety, cost and compatibility; rollback/reference fallback is rehearsed.
acceptance: No irreversible change lands without migration/reconciliation semantics.

implementation_notes: Evaluation Farm exposes health/readiness distinct from semantic correctness plus bounded diagnostic/support evidence.
